scope: Frozen old-boundary raw paths only; candidate scores are not trained policy outcomes; artificial cutoff scores are partial

formulas.potential4: T+4*(.99*phi_next-phi)-risk-.05; phi=-max(d-.5,0)/(D0+max(d-.5,0)); zero next phi for physical/goal/budget terminals, retain for artificial cutoff

calculation_method: Read all raw executed paths; recompute continuous best and endpoint distances; reuse recorded terminal/risk/time; no policy rerun or candidate advantage inference
